messages:
sam-support: FYI, customer (AcmeBio) hit 500s + elevated latency during bulk embeddings. They also referenced a pen-test finding about KMS metadata exposure (PT-2026-04). Repro steps and logs below — @maria-infosec @jon-eng please triage.

maria-infosec: thx. can you paste the pen-test id + original repro? need to map to evidence ticket.

pen-test-bot: Finding PT-2026-04 created by pen-test-eng. Severity: Medium. Title: 'KMS key alias enumeration via error messages'. Steps: enumerate aliases by repeatedly hitting /v1/embeddings with malformed key header. See /internal/pentest/pt-2026-04.

sam-support: repro (customer):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "X-Customer-ID: acme-bio" \
  -d '{"inputs": ["long text...", ... 50 items]}'
```
Response snapshot:
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"Key lookup failed for alias 'projects/prod/keys/rdw-embed-01'"}
```
Server log excerpt (redacted):
```
[2026-04-02T14:02:12Z] request_id=abc123 svc=embed-worker key_alias=rdw-embed-01 kms_status=NOT_FOUND
[2026-04-02T14:02:12Z] request_id=abc123 error="kms lookup failed: alias not found"
```

jon-eng: thanks. quick notes: we deployed a defensive check to silence raw KMS errors from being returned in April patch (PR #4127). It landed to main but we put staging-only rollout for Dedicated clusters due to a config edge. Might not be present on us-west-2-ded-3.

tasha-ops: confirm cluster and org?

sam-support: org: acme-bio, cluster: us-west-2-ded-3, created 2025-11. Customer on reserved capacity.

tasha-ops: we held rollout to avoid perf flakiness on heavy batching. I'll push the patch to us-west-2-ded-3 as a canary with affinity=1, monitor 15m.

maria-infosec: also, pen-test flagged severity because error message leak + potential alias enumeration. I think 'medium' is OK but we need to validate NO unauth access to KMS metadata. For retest we need:
- CloudTrail KMS GetKeyPolicy/GetKey requests (redact ARNs)
- Audit logs showing no principal from unprivileged accounts
- Signed log snapshot from the time window

jon-eng: can generate signed audit snapshot from log-archiver. I'll produce a redactable bundle.

sam-support: uploaded artifacts to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/pt-2026-04/acme-bio/logs-20260402.tar.gz (private link) — pinged via support ticket #S-2026-981.

tasha-ops: starting rollout now. ETA 00:20.

pen-test-bot: scheduling automated retest at 2026-04-02T15:00:00Z. Will attempt repro and produce result summary.

maria-infosec: once rollout done, please don't run full enumeration against customer production; use the dedicated pentest harness against a replay of the same request shape. We need to avoid causing impact.

jon-eng: ack. will replay requests against isolated harness using recorded payloads. logs will show if KMS error strings still bubble up.

sam-support: customer notified: we are rolling a hotfix and will re-run validations. They asked for ETA; gave 1h.

tasha-ops: rollout complete to us-west-2-ded-3 in 18m. monitoring: no error spikes, 95th latency steady. patch: https://git.redwood.internal/r/4127

pen-test-bot: retest complete: unable to reproduce alias enumeration. Requests returned 400 on malformed headers but no KMS error content. Summary attached: /internal/pentest/results/pt-2026-04-acme-bio.json

maria-infosec: received signed log bundle from jon (+1). I reviewed CloudTrail — no suspicious GetKey calls from anon principals. Based on evidence I agree to downgrade severity to Low and mark PT-2026-04 as remediated for production. Please ensure we run a regression test in 2 weeks.

jon-eng: will add regression test to ci/pentest-harness and schedule weekly smoke for Dedicated clusters.

sam-support: closing loop with customer; will follow up in ticket S-2026-981. :thumbsup: 

tasha-ops: leaving note: if similar reports come in, follow canary rollout checklist and ping eng-security before mass rollout.

pen-test-bot: PT-2026-04 status: Remediated (Low). Closing in 24h unless reopened.
